question: The minimum distance of distinct vision for a young adult person with no defect in eyes is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**25 cm.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

 
• **25 cm** is the** average minimum distance** of distinct vision for a young adult person with **no defect **in eyes.
 
• The **minimum distance of distinct vision** is the closest distance at which a person can see an object clearly.</l
